name: sc-web
//engines: jsdom 30 declares `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`, so 24.15.0 is a real floor now rather than a preference. CI's NODE_VERSION is "24", which setup-node floats to the newest 24.x (24.18.1, the Active LTS), and the Dockerfile pins node:24-alpine. Both satisfy it. Stated here so a developer on an older 24.x gets a warning at install time instead of an unexplained vitest failure.
//packageManager: Pinned because corepack otherwise installs whatever pnpm it happens to bundle, and the overrides this project's security pins live in are read from pnpm-workspace.yaml, which older pnpm does not consult. An image built with the wrong one resolves the vulnerable transitive dependency and says nothing.
//overrides: The cookie pin for GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which is where this project's package manager reads overrides from. Stated there rather than here so there is one copy to keep correct.
